_comment: Golden fixture for sleeves.rules.senses daily-bar indicator math (AC-4). Every series below is a hand-constructed, deterministic close-price list -- never captured from a live feed. Tests in tests/sleeves/rules/test_senses.py NEVER assert a hardcoded indicator output: they recompute SMA/EMA/RSI/momentum/realized_vol/drawdown_from_high from these raw closes via the exact formula pinned in senses.py's docstring contract, then compare that derived value to sleeves.rules.senses.sense_indicator's return. This fixture only supplies the raw inputs.
_provenance: Schema-derived: plain float closes, not a captured Alpaca bar payload (senses.sense_indicator's contract takes `closes: list[float]` directly -- callers extract closes from synthetic_history.fetch_bars/lens_technicals-style bar dicts before calling in production).

mixed_series._comment: 20 closes, mixed up/down deltas -- exercises SMA/EMA/RSI/momentum/realized_vol with a non-degenerate gain/loss mix.

monotonic_up_series._comment: 16 strictly increasing closes -- every day is a gain, zero losses. Exercises the RSI avg_loss==0 edge case (RSI must be exactly 100, not a divide-by-zero crash).

monotonic_down_series._comment: 16 strictly decreasing closes -- every day is a loss, zero gains. Exercises the RSI avg_gain==0 edge case (RSI must be exactly 0).

insufficient_series._comment: Only 3 closes -- shorter than every window under test (5/10/14) and shorter than momentum's window+1 requirement. Every indicator call against this series must return available=False, never an IndexError/ZeroDivisionError.

drawdown_series._comment: Peaks at 110.0 (index 2) then declines to 104.0 -- exercises drawdown_from_high with a genuine peak-to-trough gap, distinct from the mostly-monotonic mixed_series (whose running high is its own last bar, giving a trivial zero drawdown).
